subject: Include records from photos that have not been tagged with a species ID in record table

messages.author: 6ee174225c526ede
messages.subject: Include records from photos that have not been tagged with a species ID in record table
parts:
Hi Jürgen
Thank-you for developing such a great package for analysing wildlife survey image data.
We are currently systematically deploying remote cameras to survey small mammals. One of the challenges when tagging images of small mammals is that they cannot always be identified to species level with a high level of confidence. As a result we have tagged our images with a range of tags additional to species including confidence of species ID, mammal group (small, medium, or large mammal, bird or invertebrate), and camera malfunction including misalignment resulting from a bump by a large animal, or glitch in date and time. This means that not all images are tagged with a species id.
I really like the set-up of the output of your record table function. Is there any way to specify for the record table to include all images (and not exclude those without a species ID)?
We would use this information to make an assessment of camera performance (e.g. proportion of images that could be attributed to a given small mammal with high confidence), and perhaps even model the occupancy dynamics of mammal groupings e.g. small mammals.
The code we are using to construct our dataframe is as follows.
Many thanks for your time.

rec.db.species_metadata <- recordTable(inDir = raw_images, IDfrom = "metadata", cameraID = "directory", camerasIndependent = TRUE, metadataSpeciesTag = "Species", metadataHierarchyDelimitor = "|", minDeltaTime = 0, timeZone = "Australia/Tasmania", removeDuplicateRecords = FALSE, returnFileNamesMissingTags = TRUE, writecsv = FALSE,additionalMetadataTags = c("EXIF:Model", "EXIF:Make", "metadata_IDConfidenceScore","metadata_Group","metadata_CameraMalfunction"))

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Include records from photos that have not been tagged with a species ID in record table
parts:
Hi Bill,

apologies for the late reply. Currently you can't make recordTable return records without tags (when using metadata species ID). I believe the easiest solution would be to assign species tags even to those images without an animal in the frame (e.g. "empty", "unknown", or whatever may be the case).

You can use the digiKam "Filters" menu on the right side of the screen to easily list the species without tags (how exactly to do it depends on whether there are other tags assigned already (then "Images Without Tags" won't work), but I'm sure with a little experimentation you can make it work.

After assigning some placeholder species tags to the images without animals, the information of those images will be extracted as if they are species, and can be used in whatever analyses you are planning to do.

Side note, I think you don't need

in additionalMetadataTag. All metdata tags (from digiKam for example) should be extracted automatically.

Best regards,

Jürgen
